description: This file implements the ListView functionality for the Vtiger CRM module, handling list display, sorting, filtering, custom views, navigation, and rendering via Smarty templates.

classes.name: CustomView
classes.description: Handles custom view management including view IDs, permissions, and view HTML.

classes.name: QueryGenerator
classes.description: Builds database queries for list views based on filters, sorting, and custom views.

classes.name: ListViewController
classes.description: Manages retrieval of list view headers and entries, and search options.

methods.name: getViewId
methods.description: Retrieves the current view ID for the custom view.

methods.name: getCustomViewCombo
methods.description: Generates HTML for custom view selection dropdown.

methods.name: getCustomViewByCvid
methods.description: Fetches details of a custom view by its ID.

methods.name: initForCustomViewById
methods.description: Initializes query generator for a specific custom view.

methods.name: initForDefaultCustomView
methods.description: Initializes query generator for default view.

methods.name: addUserSearchConditions
methods.description: Adds user-defined search conditions to the query.

methods.name: getQuery
methods.description: Returns the SQL query string for the current list view.

methods.name: getConditionalWhere
methods.description: Returns the WHERE clause conditions for filtering.

methods.name: getListViewHeader
methods.description: Retrieves the list view header configuration.

methods.name: getListViewEntries
methods.description: Retrieves the list view data entries.
